items.name: Sherwin-Williams
items.headline: Narrows 2026 adjusted EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $6,860.0M versus $6,358.2M, diluted EPS $3.38 versus $3.35, and 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance is now $11.85-$12.15.
items.thesis: Net income fell to $821.0M from $833.1M even as sales rose 7.9%. The company expects a mid-single-digit sales increase in Q4.

items.name: TransUnion
items.headline: Raises 2026 adjusted EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $1,312.5M versus $1,169.5M, adjusted diluted EPS $1.25 versus $1.10, and 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance is $4.81-$4.88.
items.thesis: GAAP diluted EPS was $0.81 versus $0.49. The release says it is maintaining the high end of revenue guidance while raising adjusted EPS guidance.

items.name: Illinois Tool Works
items.headline: Narrows 2026 GAAP EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $4,236M versus $4,059M, GAAP EPS $3.00 versus $2.81, and 2026 GAAP EPS guidance is a narrowed $11.45-$11.55.
items.thesis: Organic revenue growth was 3.8% and operating margin was 27.8%, up 40 basis points.

items.name: Boeing
items.headline: Reports record backlog alongside a Q3 loss
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $24,188M versus $23,270M, diluted loss per share $0.26 versus $7.14, free cash flow $464M, and total backlog a record $745B.
items.thesis: Operating cash flow was $1,496M versus $1,123M a year earlier.

items.name: Hubbell
items.headline: Raises 2026 adjusted EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $1,872.5M versus $1,502.4M, adjusted diluted EPS $5.91 versus $5.17, and 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is now $20.40-$20.60.
items.thesis: GAAP diluted EPS was $4.94 versus $4.77, a smaller gain than adjusted EPS.

items.name: Centene
items.headline: Raises 2026 EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 revenues were $50,647M versus $49,690M, adjusted diluted EPS $0.58 versus $0.50, and 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is now greater than $5.20, up $0.40.
items.thesis: At-risk membership fell to 25,698,200 from 27,968,100 a year earlier, while the health benefits ratio was 92.7%, unchanged.
